items.heading: 2 Compare with Free Alternatives
items.text: 2 Compare with Free Alternatives 2 Compare with free alternatives first ICAI hosts its Foundation study material on its own knowledge portal. CFA Institute and GARP offer study tools alongside the exam. YouTube, past papers and official syllabi cost nothing. Sample the subject before you pay for structure.

items.heading: CA Is the Clearest Case
items.text: CA is the clearest case of a multi-stage race. You clear a hard entry exam, then a harder middle stage, then two years of training where you compete for a good firm, then a Final with a lower pass rate than most people expect. Each stage is a separate filter.

The law or a licensing board decides who may do the work. No course, portfolio or free video can replace the credential. Plan the full route, because a skill alone will not open this door.
The credential is a strong signal
Employers use these letters to filter applications, and the learning is real. Few jobs are legally closed without them, so the work you can show next to the letters still counts.
Tally, Excel and Power BI courses, NISM exams for sales roles
The paper matters only because it points to something you built. These are add-ons, not a replacement for a professional route.

items.heading: 1 Judge the Specific Course,
items.text: 1 Judge the specific course, not the body ICAI, ICSI, ACCA and CFA Institute set the exams. The coaching class, tutor or prep pack you buy is a separate product. Check the tutor, the last update date, the test series, refund terms and two real student results.

items.heading: 3 Ask What You Will
items.text: 3 Ask what you will produce, not what you will pass Articleship, ACCA work experience and CFA work hours force real output. Add your own: a set of practice GST returns, a small valuation model, a reconciliation file. A plan with no output is just a study timetable.

items.heading: 4 Remember That Certificates Alone
items.text: 4 Remember that certificates alone are weak proof A CFA Level I pass or a set of ACCA papers without the work behind them does not make you a charterholder or member. Employers ask what you did with it. Where the credential is a licence, it is the product. Otherwise it supports the work, not replaces it.

items.heading: 5 Count the Cost
items.text: 5 Count the cost of outdated or wasted learning Rules change. ICAI moved to a new scheme in July 2023. ICSI restructured CSEET from June 2026. ACCA starts a redesigned structure in 2027. The US CPA changed its exam format in 2024. Old notes and a coaching batch built on the old syllabus are money lost.

figures.label: Time Required
figures.source: Foundation registration is valid for 4 years from your first eligible attempt, with no revalidation. Intermediate is valid for 5 years and can be revalidated once for 5 more. Final is valid for 10 years. A slow start has a deadline.

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: ICAI lists Rs 9,000 for Foundation, Rs 18,000 for Intermediate and Rs 22,000 for Final. That adds to Rs 49,000 before exam forms, short courses and coaching. ICAI recommends minimum articleship stipends of Rs 3,000 to Rs 6,000 a month for the two-year scheme, by city size and year (the 2024 FAQ says the rule change was still pending), so training does not pay for your study.
